purpose: base-uri has no default-src fallback, so an explicit wildcard base-uri allows base-tag hijacking and must be reported even under a restrictive policy.

groundTruth.rationale: The policy sets default-src 'none' and then permits any origin as the document base. A base element from anywhere would rewrite relative URLs, which the rest of the policy cannot prevent.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The rule reports the permission, not a demonstrated base-element injection.
